name: Zhejiang FORE Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang FORE Intelligent Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research, production, distribution, and service of air tools and gears. Its products include small module steel gears, pneumatic tools, precision reducers, harmonic reducers, and spare parts, and new energy. The company's products are used power tools, agricultural and forestry machinery, medical devices, smart home devices, ultra-high voltage power grids, industrial sewing machines, aerospace, automotive, robotics, power tools, agricultural and forestry machinery, medical devices, smart home, ultra-high voltage power. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Taizhou, China.
